description: Approach-based review of the fix for the visual defect described in instruction.md: in the Leader Den screen's other-clan tile (the clickable card that shows a neighbouring clan's name, temperament, and standing toward the player's clan), the standing text was not showing correctly. These criteria judge how the fix was implemented from the diff alone; whether it actually renders correctly (visible on hover, full text preserved, hover feedback intact, across varied content) is verified empirically by tests/test.patch, not re-judged here.

criteria.criterion: In the other-clan tile built by create_other_clan_selection_box in scripts/screens/LeaderDenScreen.py (or a companion resource it references, such as a theme file), the fix repositions or respaces the tile's child elements - the standing-text label, the clan-name/temperament labels above it, their shared container, or the hover-border decoration itself - to create vertical clearance for the standing text.

In the other-clan tile built by create_other_clan_selection_box in scripts/screens/LeaderDenScreen.py (or a companion resource it references, such as a theme file), the fix addresses the standing text's placement generally, based on the tile's layout and the actual length of the content above it, rather than special-casing the specific clan name, temperament words, or standing value used to reproduce the bug.
